title: Rainy Night Requiem
premise: In the aftermath of his daughter's tragic death, former cop turned PI Jack Slade takes on a case that threatens to reopen old wounds. As he delves deeper into the truth behind a missing persons case from his troubled past, he's forced to confront the darkness that haunts him still.

characters.name: Jack Slade
characters.description: Ex-cop turned PI with a taste for whiskey and a penchant for getting in over his head

characters.name: Sarah Jenkins
characters.description: Missing persons victim whose trail leads Jack down a rabbit hole of memories and nightmares

established_facts: Sarah Marie Jenkins was 17 years old when she disappeared.
Starlight Theater is near the city limits where Sarah worked on her last known night.
Frank Jenkins passed a worn briefcase containing minimal belongings to Jack Slade.
Sarah Jenkins was married, not divorced
Lily died in a fire that also killed her children
Marcus is mentioned as driving an ATV
Sarah left the black leather jacket on the door hook
The last time Jack's daughter, Lily, felt alive was while wearing the denim duster
Sarah Jenkins left her husband, who is referred to as Marcus.
Kael (no established connection) appears at the end of this chapter, riding a motorcycle with Sarah.
Bubba Fothergill was tattooed in black leather; Bubba killed his wife; Pogo died on blood-soaked dirt, shot by Sarah Marie's mother's hand
style_terms: Red Rock Station: always Red Rock (capital 'R'), no hyphens
